title: FLOW v1 maker execution optimistic-bound audit

source.note: Forward shadow telemetry; only about 3 UTC days, not an independent long holdout.

coverage.note: Counts increased during live collection between read-only queries.

optimistic_bounds.description: Exploratory upper-bound arithmetic only; it does not model queue position, fill probability, latency or adverse selection and therefore is more favorable than executable maker trading.
one_maker_assumptions: replace one 5 bps taker fee with 2 bps maker fee
remove one 3 bps minimum adverse slippage
two_maker_assumptions: apply the one-maker improvement on both legs
use entry spread as a favorable proxy for both legs
assume both passive orders fill with no queue loss or adverse selection

decision.reason: FLOW v1 does not approach PF>1.15 or positive net expectancy even under an impossible guaranteed two-sided maker-fill upper bound. A real post-only implementation would add missed fills, queue uncertainty and adverse selection.
decision.next_research_rule: Do not spend a new forward shadow on maker execution for this unchanged signal. A future microstructure experiment must change the alpha hypothesis itself and preregister actual fill rules.

limitations: The maker calculations are deliberately optimistic bounds, not backtests or fill simulations.
The sample spans only about three UTC days and was observed after FLOW v1 was designed.
No historical best-bid/ask archive was used.
No claim of profitability is made.
